id.title: Id
id.description: The id of the step this metric belongs to (matches steps.id).

provider_id.title: Provider Id
provider_id.description: The unique identifier of the provider.

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: The unique identifier of the run.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: The unique identifier of the agent.

step_start_ns.title: Step Start Ns
step_start_ns.description: The timestamp of the start of the step in nanoseconds.

llm_request_start_ns.title: Llm Request Start Ns
llm_request_start_ns.description: The timestamp of the start of the llm request in nanoseconds.

llm_request_ns.title: Llm Request Ns
llm_request_ns.description: Time spent on LLM requests in nanoseconds.

tool_execution_ns.title: Tool Execution Ns
tool_execution_ns.description: Time spent on tool execution in nanoseconds.

step_ns.title: Step Ns
step_ns.description: Total time for the step in nanoseconds.

base_template_id.title: Base Template Id
base_template_id.description: The base template ID that the step belongs to (cloud only).

template_id.title: Template Id
template_id.description: The template ID that the step belongs to (cloud only).

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: The project that the step belongs to (cloud only).
